warnings.headline: Strong wind gusts, yellow level, Parts of Finnmark and Troms, 2026-11-09T08:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-09T23:00:00+00:00
warnings.description: Locally strong wind gusts around 30-35 m/s are expected from west, and occasionally storm force 10 at the coast. The wind will increase first in western part, and decrease last in eastern part.
warnings.instruction: Secure loose objects: Consider taking precautions to prevent damage before the event occurs. Avoid unnecessary travel in exposed areas. Risk of traffic obstructions: Check road reports on vegvesen.no/trafikk. Risk of cancelled departures: Follow advice and check the status from transport operators. Locally high waves: Be cautious when traveling on water.
